chunks: For some of us are upright and some otherwise: Surely we follow different ways.
ai.seo_question: What does the Quran say about the different types of Jinn?
ai.summary: This verse from Surah Al-Jinn (72:11) elucidates the moral diversity among the Jinn, paralleling the human condition by distinguishing between the righteous (Salihun) and the rest who followed divergent paths (Tara'iq Qiddan). In Shia exegesis, this plurality underscores the universal nature of free will and the necessity of guidance, as the Jinn, like humans, are subject to divine judgment based on their adherence to truth amidst competing sects.
